item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a strong 2024 example of Kishida firing or publicly replacing a clearly ineffective minister, agency head, or senior implementer. The visible corrections were mostly institutional: political-funds reform, disclosure changes, third-party audits, reserve-budget reallocation, evidence-based budgeting, and finally stepping aside.
